О бессмертии человек мечтал с давних времен. Чтобы продлить жизнь, наши предки пили кровь, варили различные зелья и проводили магические ритуалы. Сотни лет алхимики и маги искали ключ в вечную жизнь на Земле. Увы, безуспешно. Отыскать уникальный рецепт бессмертия не удалось никому из них.

К Доктору обратилась Вера Афонина, которую беспокоит тяжесть в грудной клетке и одышка. Доктор диагностирует у нее остеохондроз грудного отдела позвоночника и связывает ухудшение в ее состоянии с нервным напряжением, которое она испытывает. Вера считает причиной своих проблем свекровь, которая раздражает ее своей бестактностью и навязчивостью. Она подозревает мать мужа в желании довести их пару до развода. Эксперт - Егоров

Абсолютно новый проект на ТВ-3! Он живет уединенно в лесу, вдали от городской суеты и волнений. Но его деревянный дом, полный света и тепла, становится маяком для всякого, кто потерял надежду и заблудился в лабиринте жизни. Ведь он тот, кто видит судьбу...

Проект о таинственных знаках судьбы, необычных стечениях обстоятельств и загадочных историях из жизни. Даже самые упрямые реалисты сталкиваются с вещами, которые нельзя объяснить логикой. Знаки судьбы окружают нас повсюду. Чтобы найти к ним путь, нужно увидеть и расшифровать их…

Иван Доронин — один из лучших бойцов спецназа СОБР. Во время операции по освобождению заложников мужчина получает серьезное ранение, из-за которого его отправляют в отпуск. В это же время Ивану сообщают о смерти бывшей жены, с которой тот почти не общался, лишь исправно платил алименты за сына Мишу. Доронин едет в родную деревню Медвежье, чтобы забрать ребенка. Но на месте узнает, что у его супруги есть еще один сын, от другого мужчины. И живут оба мальчика вместе с отчимом Доронина. Иван остается в Медвежьем для оформления опекунства над Мишей. Параллельно герою приходится подменять внезапно заболевшего отчима на работе в качестве почтальона. Развозя по окрестностям корреспонденцию, Иван то и дело попадает в сложные ситуации, где навыки спецназовца оказываются как нельзя кстати.

Formans atgriežas Prinstonas-Pleinsboro slimnīcā un tiek nozīmēts pieskatīt kandidātus uz Hausa komandu. Slimnīcā ievests vīrietis, kurš ticis aplaupīts, un viņam sākušies elpošanas traucējumi. Viņš nespēj atcerēties neko par sevi, tomēr ļoti labi spēj nolasīt telpā esošo cilvēku personības, kas liecina par kādu retu slimību.

Hausa palīdzību lūdz CIP, lai palīdzētu noteikt diagnozi aģentei, kura, pēc visa spriežot, mirst. CIP sniedz maz informācijas par aģentes dzīvi un viņas iepriekšējiem uzdevumiem, tāpēc Hauss spiests izmantot netradicionālas metodes, lai glābtu pacientes dzīvību. Formens tikmēr mēģina noskaidrot, kas noticis autorallija braucējai, un Hausa komandas kandidāti sāk apšaubīt viņa profesionalitāti.

Kurš gan nezina Reksi - lielisko policistu palīgu. Nu iepazīstieties ar Aleksu! Vācu aitu suns Alekss ir labākais izmeklētājs visā Polijas policijā. Tomēr pēc Aleksa drauga un kolēģa nāves policistu starpā rodas šaubas, vai suns spēs pārvarēt lielās sirdssāpes. Par laimi, jaunais komisārs Mareks Bromskis spēj iekarot viņa uzticību, un suņu puika atkal luncina asti un ir gatavs mesties noziedzniekiem pa pēdām. Alekss pat sadraudzējas ar Mareka izveicīgo kolēģi Lūsiju, kura ir nesen šķīrusies un viena audzina savus dvīņu puikas. Policijā darba netrūkst nekad, un ar Aleksu pie sāniem Mareks un viņa komanda ir gatavi stāties pretī jebkuram pārbaudījumam.

"Galvas un astes" - iecienītākais ceļojumu šovs dažādu seju, dzimumu un vecumu ceļotājiem. Viena pilsēta un divi vadītāji. Bet vienam no viņiem ir simts dolāru, kas paredzēti visām izklaidēm, bet otram ir zelta bankas karte. Tas ir monētas metiens. Jūs esat miljonārs vai nabags. Jūs dzīvojat greznā dzīvoklī vai guļat hostelī. Jūs pusdienojat augstas klases restorānā vai paēdat pieticīgā ātrās ēdināšanas ēstuvē. Taču zelta karte nenozīmē neaizmirstamas brīvdienas. Dažkārt pietiek pat ar simts dolāriem, lai ceļojums būtu neaizmirstams uz visiem laikiem.

Nikolass Keidžs jūtas radoši nepiepildīts un atrodas bankrota priekšā, tomēr cer iegūt lomu jaunākajā Tarantino filmā. Lai nopelnītu miljonu dolāru, viņš piekrīt piedalīties sava fana miljardiera dzimšanas dienas ballītē. Drīz vien Keidžu savervē CIP aģente, lai ar aktiera palīdzību iegūtu informāciju par šo bagātnieku - narkotiku karteļa vadoni. Situācija vēl vairāk sarežģās, kad ballītē ierodas Keidža bijusī sieva un meita.

Krimināli dokumentāls drāmas seriāls, kurā tiek izmeklēti sarežģīti kriminālprocesi. Katra sērija ir atsevišķs stāsts, kas balstīts uz reāliem notikumiem. Daudzi šādi noziegumi varētu palikt neatklāti un vainīgais – izvairīties no soda, ja vien izmeklētāja atklātā detaļa nekļūtu par pavedienu uz atrisinājumu: nomesta matu sprādze, pazaudēta poga vai ielikta zīmīte - lietiskie pierādījumi.

Miruši divi vīrieši, kuri strādājuši par prostitūtām pie izmeklētājiem "iemīļotās" Heteres. Viens nogalināts kādā visai slapjā naktsklubā, otrs - miris savās mājās. CSI izmeklētāji dodas sievieti apciemot. Tikmēr Ketrīna saņem ziņu no meitas, kura viena atrodas slīkstošā mašīnā, bet tas nav vienīgais, kas jāpārdzīvo izmeklētājai.

Ieskaties vienas no Austrālijas lielākās un noslogotākās medicīnas iestādes, Melburnas Karaliskās slimnīcas, neatliekamās palīdzības nodaļas ikdienā. Nežēlīgi uzbrukumi, šausminošas avārijas, traumatiski negadījumi un katastrofas - katru dienu slimnīcā nonāk cilvēki ar dzīvībai bīstamiem ievainojumiem. Tad pie darba ķeras augsti kvalificēti ārsti un medmāsas un nenogurstoši cīnās par savu pacientu dzīvībām. Spriedze, emocijas, brīnumainas izglābšanās un traģiski zaudējumi - aiz šīs slimnīcas sienām notiek it viss. Sāpju asaras mijas ar laimīgiem smaidiem.

"Četri uz koferiem" noslēdzošā diena Latgalē solās būt piedzīvojumiem bagāta! Šīs dienas plānošanu ir uzņēmies restorānu īpašnieks Andris Rūmītis. Viņš par pārsteigumiem rūpējas jau no paša rīta, sarīkojot pārējiem izbraucienu ar padomju laika Moskvich markas automobili. Tālāk visiem tiek piedāvāta pārģērbšanās spēle un, protams, arī tradicionālā latgaliešu virtuve ar īstiem muzikantiem. Nepalaid garām, kā noslēgsies šis ceļojums pa Latviju!

Erudīcijas spēle katram darbdienu vakaram! Katru vakaru 15 jautājumi, viens uzvarētājs un 150 eiro balva. Spēli vada radio personība, dīdžejs un pasākumu vadītājs Magnuss Eriņš, bet par vakara erudītākā cilvēka titulu sacenšas divi dalībnieki. Noteikumi ir pavisam vienkārši - katram dalībniekam priekšā ir poga, kas kļūst aktīva, līdzko izskanējis jautājums. Kurš pirmais šo pogu nospiež, tas izvēlas jautājuma likteni - vai pats vēlas uz to atbildēt cerībā nopelnīt divus punktus, vai arī pirmo iespēju dot konkurentam, lai pats pēc tam mēģinātu tikt pie viena punkta. Kurš atbildējis pirmais un pareizi, tas tiek pie diviem punktiem, kurš otrais - pie viena, bet par nepareizu atbildi punkti nepienākas. Kuram vakara beigās vairāk punktu, tas arī uzvarētājs! Uzvarētājs saņem 150 eiro balvu un iespēju piedalīties nākamā vakara spēlē.

Slavenā NCIS Losandželosas īpašā vienība ķeras pie darba! Augsti kvalificēti, pieredzējuši un spējīgi - viņi tiek piesaistīti lietās, kurās uz spēles ir valsts drošība. Komandu vada augumā necilā, tomēr ļoti spējīgā Hetija, kuras apskaužamās zināšanas, skarbā attieksme un ciešais skatiens iedveš bailes kā noziedzniekiem, tā viņas padotajiem. Īpašais aģents Džī Kalens iepriekš stradājis FIB, Narkotiku apkarošanas administrācijā un Centrālajā izlūkošanas pārvaldē, bet viņa pārinieks Sems Hanna ir ar militāru un sporta pieredzi, un kopā ar savu uzticamo komandu viņi ir neapturami un spēj aizturēt pat visrūdītākos noziedzniekus.

Īpašā izmeklētāju vienība detektīva Maka Teilora vadībā šķetina noziegumus tumšākajos Ņujorkas nostūros. Viņi ir kā savdabīga ģimene, kurus vieno spēcīga taisnīguma izjūta. Lai atklātu sarežģītās krimināllietas, viņi izmanto progresīvākās metodes, pretstatā tradicionālajiem izmeklēšanas paņēmieniem. Katra ir lieta kā rēbuss, kuru komanda risina, analizējot katru detaļu un pavedienu.

Šīs nedēļas noslēgumā "Gandrīz ideālajās vakariņās" viesi - bārmenis Mārtiņš Rozenvalds, realitātes šova "Ģimene burkā" dalībniece Vita Valtere un aktieris Kaspras Zāle, dosies ciemos pie rakstnieces Daces Rukšānes. Dace savās lauku mājās viesiem būs sarūpējusi Michelin cienīgu maltīti, kuras pagatavošanai netrūks ne laika, ne pacietības - piemēram, liellopa mērce tapusi, to astoņas stundas rūpīgi reducējot. Pirms vakariņām viesi dosies ekskursijā pa Daces lauku īpašumu un aplūkos arī iespaidīgo grāmatu plauktu, taču izrādās - daži no viesiem labprātāk sarunāsies ar laukakmeni nekā cits ar citu. Vakariņu laikā ikvienam būs jāparāda savas radošās spējas un jāsacer dzejolis. Vai šis uzdevums kādam no slavenību četrotnes kļūs par lielāko klupšanas akmeni vai tomēr pārsteigs ar negaidīti labu rezultātu? Un, protams, vakars noslēgsies uz saldas nots - ar desertu, kas pieliks punktu šīs nedēļas "Gandrīz ideālajām vakariņām". Kurš no četrotnes tiks sumināts kā nedēļas uzvarētājs?
Sadursme 360 ir 10 minūšu ikdienas operatīvo drošības dienestu ziņu raidījums ar galveno uzsvaru uz ceļu satiksmes drošību.

360 Ziņas ir dinamisks un mūsdienīgs TOP7 dienas svarīgāko Latvijas un pasaules notikumu apskats, kas palīdz saprast, kāpēc tas ir svarīgi tieši tev. TOP7 apvieno ātru tempu, saprotamu valodu, dažādus viedokļus un cilvēku pieredzes, kā arī skaidrojošu pieeju bez informācijas pārslodzes un liekvārdības, palīdzot orientēties informatīvajā troksnī un īsā laikā ar TOP7 iegūt skaidru priekšstatu par dienas būtiskāko.

Erudīcijas un taktikas spēlē "Viens pret visiem" spēles dalībnieki stāsies duelī ar zināmām Latvijas personībām, katram liekot galdā savu trumpi - slavenībām talkā būs erudīti eksperti, bet pretiniekam - pirmais gājiens un iespēja taktiski izvēlēties tēmas, tostarp sev neērtākos jautājumus piespēlējot slavenībai. Katrā spēlē būs jauns spēlētājs, bet sabiedrībā zināmās personības komanda būs nemainīga visu nedēļu. Par spēles tempu, azartu un jautājumiem savukārt parūpēsies Gustavs Terzens. Kurš no dalībniekiem savu trumpi izspēlēs gudrāk? Vai uzvaru izšķirs zināšanas, taktika vai spēja riskēt īstajā brīdī?

"Slavenības. Bez filtra" atkal ver durvis slavenību dzīvei bez izskaistināšanas tur, kur emocijas, attiecību drāmas un skaļākie ikdienas mirkļi notiek pa īstam. Viņi uzdrīkstas iet savu ceļu un būt paši, īsti un drosmīgi! Ikviens varēs pievienoties Kaspara un Olgas Kambalu, latgalietes Margaritas Kolosovas, dzejnieces Magones Liedeskalnas un influenceru Sindijas Bokānes un Nika Endziņa ikdienai, kā arī raudzīt jaunas sejas, tostarp skaistuma dīvu Kristīni Lindenblati.

Kad Rīgas 9. klases skolniece pēc stundām neatgriežas mājās, viņas tuvinieku pasaule sāk brukt kā kāršu namiņš. Policijas neatlaidīgie meklējumi atklāj asinis stindzinošus notikumus - pilsētas ielu labirintos slēpjas patiesība, kas ir daudz baisāka par vienkāršu bēgšanu no mājām. Šī ir viena no krimināllietām, kas pēdējo divdesmit gadu laikā būtiski ietekmējusi Latvijas sabiedrību. Raidījums atklāj ne tikai noziegumu gaitu, bet arī sabiedrības tumšākās puses un to, kā ikviens var pasargāt sevi un citus. Raidījums tapis ciešā sadarbībā ar izmeklētājiem, advokātiem, kriminālistikas ekspertiem un pieredzējušiem žurnālistiem, apkopojot līdz šim maz zināmas detaļas un arhīvu materiālus.

Raidījums atklāj ne tikai noziegumu gaitu, bet arī sabiedrības tumšākās puses un to, kā ikviens var pasargāt sevi un citus. Raidījums tapis ciešā sadarbībā ar izmeklētājiem, advokātiem, kriminālistikas ekspertiem un pieredzējušiem žurnālistiem, apkopojot līdz šim maz zināmas detaļas un arhīvu materiālus.

Inspektors Fins Kīzeveters kopā ar pārinieku Larsu Englenu un uzticamo komandu atkal izmeklē noziegumus Lībekā un tās apkārtnē. Noziedznieki nesnauž, un darba inspektoriem netrūkst - vai ik dienas lielpilsētā notiek uzbrukumi, nolaupīšanas, slepkavības! Un vainīgie tiks atrasti. Galvenajās lomās: Svens Martineks, Ingo Naujoks, Petra Kellinga.

Interesantu tikšanos, sirsnīgu stāstu un aizkustinošu pateicību šovs "Pasaki to skaļi" atklāj jau 7. sezonu! Elīna Fīrmane kopā ar Roberto Meloni uz studiju aicinās dažādas un spilgtas personības, lai uzklausītu viņu stāstus un uzzinātu, kam tieši viņi ir pateicīgi par kādu nozīmīgu pavērsienu savā dzīvē. Pārsteigumi, siltas un iepriecinošas satikšanās un sirsnīgi pateicības vārdi - tas viss dara šo pasauli gaišāku un iedvesmo arī skatītājus ikdienā novērtēt sev apkārt esošos cilvēkus un atcerēties pateikt viņiem paldies.

Andrejs Kravecs ir godprātīgs un principiāls operatīvais darbinieks. Tieši viņa godprātība noved pie saķeršanās ar augsti stāvošu un ietekmīgu politiķi, kurš saniknojas ne pa jokam. Lai pasargātu Andreju no neparedzamām sekām, vadība pārceļ viņu no galvaspilsētas uz dzimto Odesu. Dzimtajā pilsētā Andreju jau sagaida seni draugi – bijušais bokseris Fedja, kurš nerunā daudz, bet ir uzticams līdz kaulam, un Makss – talantīgs inženieris un programmētājs. Un šī komanda noliks pie vietas ne vienu vien Odesas noziedznieku!

Kad policija ir bezspēcīga, palīgā dodas Īpašā izmeklēšanas aģentūra SLED. Tā ir īpaši izveidota struktūra policijas galvenās pārvaldes sastāvā un tieši pakļauta ģenerālim - Ukrainas Iekšlietu ministra vietniekam. Vienība nodarbojas ar īpaši skaļu, sarežģītu un smagu noziegumu izmeklēšanu. Tai pieejamas vismodernākās tehnoloģijas un valsts labākie kriminālisti un tiesu medicīnas laboratorijas. Protams, vienībā darbojas arī tikai labākie operatīvie darbinieki, kuri nepieļaus, ka kāda lieta netiktu atrisināta. Galvenajās lomās: Tatjana Kravčenko, Boriss Georgijevskijs, Aleksejs Surovcevs.

Ieskaties noziedzības pasaulē, kur divas leģendāras komandas no seriāliem "Ūdens policija" un "Izmeklēšanas aģentūra "SLED"" apvieno spēkus, lai izmeklētu vissarežģītākos noziegumus. Šī pieredzes, zināšanu un tehnoloģiju apvienošanās kļūs par īstu izaicinājumu noziedzīgajai pasaulei. Stāsts sākas ar izmeklēšanu par vairākām skaļām ārvalstu pilsoņu slepkavībām, kas vienlaikus notikušas Karpatu reģionā un Kijevā. Vēstnieki un konsuli pieprasīja nekavējoties savervēt labākos spēkus. Detektīviem darbā palīdzēs jaudīga uz mākslīgā intelekta bāzes veidota datorprogramma K.O.D. Tā ne tikai risina sarežģītas noziedznieku mīklas, bet arī nolasa izmeklēšanas dalībnieku emocionālo stāvokli.

Valentīna sastopas ar dubultu nodevību no pašu tuvāko cilvēku puses - māsīcas un labākās draudzenes, kurai viņa uzticējās no visas sirds. Safabricētu faktu dēļ Valentīna zaudē visu - līgavaini, dzimtās mājas un apkārtējo cilvēku uzticību. Kā atgūt dzīvi? Ukrainas un Latvijas kopīgi ražots seriāls.

Suddenly the US east coast is hit by a type of natural disaster formerly reserved, except after a major earthquake, for the Pacific and Indian ocean rims: tidal waves of the destructive tsunami type. Scientist and fiction author John McAdams attends a national emergency conference which concludes the phenomenon must be man-made, quite possibly abusing the findings of John's secret former Sea Lion project, but who wants to and has the means? Indeed John soon finds himself set-up for a murder and chased. Major destructions mean major contracts for construction and coastal defenses, so building tycoons like Victor Bannister certainly have a considerable interest...

Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

Part 1 of 2. The year is 1891 and Wyoming is in its first year of statehood. The three Hammett brothers, Cain, Harry and Dale, find themselves in the middle of a rapidly escalating range war that pits cattle barons against homesteaders.
Western with Burt Reynolds. Three brothers become embroiled in a rapidly escalating range war that pits old time cattle barons against homesteaders.

Murder mystery starring Dick Van Dyke (ʻChitty Chitty Bang Bangʼ) as an absent-minded and brilliant criminology professor, and his son Barry Van Dyke as an ex cop turned private investigator. When a wealthy executive is murdered in an explosion at his mansion, suspicion falls on a reporter who was working undercover on a story about corporate scandal.

Murder mystery starring Dick Van Dyke (ʻMary Poppinsʼ, ʻDiagnos is Murderʼ) as an absent-minded and brilliant criminology professor and his real-life son Barry Van Dyke as the professorʼs friend, a former cop turned private investigator. When a college professor dies in mysterious circumstances, the father-and-son team investigate.

Melanie Blame returns to their hometown Gibbington because her father, a former sheriff, is wanted for multiple murders. Jimmy Fuller wants to help find her father, and it looks as if something incredibly sinister is responsible for the corpses in Gibbington.

The eighth season of Fear begins after the conclusion of Season 7, when Morgan's (Lennie James) and Madison's (Kim Dickens) hopes to rescue Mo from PADRE did not go as planned. Now, Morgan, Madison and the others they brought to the island are living under PADRE's cynical rule. With our characters demoralized and dejected, the task of reigniting belief in a better world rests with the person Morgan and Madison set out to rescue in the first place -- Morgan's daughter, Mo.
Horror starring Jeri Ryan. A mother and her two daughters move into an ancient house in a suburb of Detroit, when it is offered at a lower price than usual.

Poignant drama starring Dana Delany (ʻDesperate Housewivesʼ, ʻBody of Proofʼ) as a bohemian artist and single mother who returns to her childhood home for a Thanksgiving family reunion. She is hoping to reconcile with her prim and proper mother (Doris Roberts, ʻMrs Miracleʼ) with whom she has always clashed, but it gradually dawns on her that her mother is in the early stages of Alzheimerʼs disease, and the whole family has to face up to reality.

Kukla, Fran and Ollie is an early American television show using puppets, originally created for children but soon watched by more adults than children. It did not have a script and was entirely ad-libbed.

When someone dies at a kennel club, McBride tries to keep the accused killer out of jail while finding out who actually committed the murder. It's quite a feat, especially when he keeps getting thrown in the slammer himself!

Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

Animal Cops: Miami is a documentary reality series following dedicated animal control officers as they provide a valuable service to the animals of Miami-Dade County. Keeping a close eye on the region's creatures, both wild and domesticated, the control officers visit various locations to investigate reports of injured or sick animals, and deplorable cases of animal cruelty, ensuring they are provided with the welfare they deserve. The series also follows individuals from the Everglades Outpost nature rehabilitation centre, as they investigate reports of animals being improperly released into the wetland area.

Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

The Vet Life is an amazing series revolving around three friends, three vets, Diarra Blue, Aubrey Ross, and Mike Lavigne and their everyday lives. These guys became friends back in University, then they worked in Las Vegas and finally moved to Texas and opened a full-service veterinary hospital of their own. The series highlights their daily routine, their duties at work and at home, their families and pets.

Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

p.d: Insane Pools: Off the Deep End is a home improvement show that follows pool designer Lucas Congdon and his team from Lucas Lagoons. Congdon and his crew renovate existing pools and build new ones on residential properties. Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

Follow a group of men and women coming from a range of backgrounds, united in their love for animals and in their mission to rescue them, as well as educate and motivate people to follow their lead. Their main concern is helping animals in need, but it is also strengthening the bond with animals that has always been present in human lives, emphasising the importance of nurturing that relationship.

Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

Nature's great predators are animals you don't want to come across, especially when you find yourself in their own backyard. In this heart-pumping documentary series, individuals share their stories of encounters with dangerous animals, reliving the frightful, life-threatening ordeal. With stories from across the world, we reveal the heart-in-mouth moments when these lucky individuals managed to escape the jaws of death. From a swimmer mauled by a bull shark in the Bahamas to a close shave with a grizzly bear in the mountains, these stories showcase the fearsome power of predators.
Owners Lisa and Callu are worried about Merlin, a Great Dane who goes over on his front toes when he walks. Neurologist Annette Wessman suspects a problem in his spine or skull.

Начальник Экспертно-криминалистической лаборатории МВД Андрей Макаров - настоящий спец. For many, an ideal existence is as far away from the bustling boulevards and city streets as is physically possible, opting to live in a serene and secluded corner of our planet. This documentary series follows teams of adventuring builders as they construct magnificent and unique properties in far-flung corners of our planet. Battling against adverse conditions, limited budgets and narrow deadlines, these crews strive to get their structures erected in time. From mountain cabins to woodland yurts, shipping container homes to lighthouse conversions, these stunning properties show the true meaning of living off the grid.

Meet the unconventional Tweto family that rules Alaska's most dangerous skies. Operating their family-run airline, Era Alaska, they battle unforgiving Alaskan weather and terrain to transport life's necessities to one of the most remote and extreme regions of America. With no freeway system for hundreds of miles, Era Alaska is the lifeline for the isolated rural inhabitants of the Bering Sea coastline. From champion snow dogs bound for the Iditarod to medicine for sick children to groceries for miners working on an operation on the North Slope, the goods that the intrepid pilots ship on any given day are crucial to everyday life.

When a local farmer from central California wants to create the ultimate roadside attraction for travelers, he recruits brothers Ron and John of Daniels Wood Land for the project. With an extremely tight deadline, the guys head back to their workshop and along with their team, design an authentic millhouse that pays tribute to the California Gold Rush days. Complete with a working windmill that will power a water wheel and stamp mill, the guys' worry their vision might be compromised when they are faced with the unexpected elements of nature. Then, an animal lover from their hometown asks the guys to build a peasant-inspired cottage to house their rescued ducks.

The Daniels Wood Land team is commissioned by Merlin Entertainment to create the first-ever, North American version of the "Dungeon" attraction in San Francisco's historic Fisherman's Wharf. This will be their largest and most demanding job yet and they need all hands on deck to create the nine-room, interactive journey that takes visitors through the city's outrageous 200-year-old history featuring a plague room complete with model cadavers and a torture chair designed to scare the wits out of the guests. Plus they will be introduced to characters such as James "Shanghai" Kelly and Miss Piggott, from the famed Miss Piggott's Saloon. The guys then rush off to Huntsville, AL, where they install a 3,000-year-old timeline log at a wild animal park belonging to a local eccentric.
Mike and Elvis try to give a rare Skoda 110R a rally inspired makeover, but they soon discover it's a bigger and more expensive job than they thought.

American petrol head and reality TV star, Richard Rawlings, famous for his show Fast N' Loud, visits struggling garages and car workshops that are desperate for a helping hand. Alongside the team of world-class mechanics from his Gas Monkey Garage, Richard invests his precious time and money to get these toiling businesses back where they belong. The team visit workshops all over the USA, using their knowledge and experience to rev up the old girls and get their engines purring once more. With a serious amount of elbow grease on top of the help from Richard's team, the owners have a shot once more at a successful business.

Join the legendary 'How It's Made' crew as they immerse themselves in automobile heaven, and discover how incredible machines are designed and created. From a Maserati to the Audi R8, from a Morgan Aero Coupe to a Porsche 911, the team travel around the world to visit the birthplaces of a host of dream cars. Each half hour episode will reveal the cars' inner workings and gorgeous exteriors, which is enhanced with unprecedented access to the factories and test labs that are integral to their conception and creation.

Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

The team goes full hazmat suit to tackle a rat-infested hoard that is rumored to have cash hidden in every room, if the rats haven't eaten it already. They also hunts for vintage Playboys, a rare samurai sword and original G.I. Joe toys.

It's late fall up in Maine and the land is supposed to be frozen and workable by now. But unceasing rain has left the forest spongy and off limits. Eventually a freeze let's them get back to work, but a veteran driver rolls his loaded truck and ends up in the hospital.

Documentary series following police officers across the USA as they put their lives on the line to enforce the law. Using real footage from the officer's body cameras, we show just how deadly routine checks can be, with law enforcement officials having to think on their feet and make split-second decisions to potentially save their, or someone else's, life. From knife-wielding maniacs to brutal shootouts, the series highlights the importance of our police departments. With interviews from the officers involved adding context to the footage, Body Cam Cops gives viewers unprecedented, exclusive access to what life is truly like in the line of duty.

Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town!

Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

When visiting Tokyo, it does not take long to realize "you're not in Kansas anymore". The massive metropolis offer a feast for the senses: blinding neon, the bleeps and blips of Pachinko parlors, adventurous cuisine and music that is experimental, animated, and sometimes, just plain unusual. On this episode of Music Voyager we get a taste of the cultural umami that is Tokyo, and it is voyage of discovery filled with surprises you will never forget. From the outlandish fashion of J - Pop, the surprising pastime of a Japanese jazz giant, Tokyo's rock guitar superstar and a humorous hip - hop freestyler, we meet the colorful characters that make Tokyo one of the world's greatest cities. Our journey is powered by ample bowls of delicio us ramen noodles, first - class shots of sake and the occasional octopus ball.

Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it. In this series of 20 films, of 26 minutes each, the habitat will be a major showcase revealing our capacity to adapt ourselves at a time where we need to find solutions in order to address immense changes.

Whether you refer to Udaipur as the City of Lakes or the City of Dawn, you are sure to agree that romance and beauty fill the air. While traveling by boat, we visit the many palaces and temples on the shore. We also tour the majestic City Palace and the Garden of the Maids of Honor. In Jaipur, we tour the Pink City, paying close attention to such architectural treasures as the Palace of Winds (Hawa Mahal) and the Amber Fort. We also visit the magnificent collections housed in the City Palace.

Journeys in India is a ground-breaking travel series focusing on the Indian subcontinent. This first season highlights the history, culture, architecture, and wildlife of one of the most mysterious and exciting areas on earth. Perfect for the would-be or armchair traveler, this 13 part series is beautifully filmed with all original footage. Join host Bill Ball as he takes you on the adventures of a lifetime!

Gold, ivory and slaves drove the economy of the East coast of Africa 500 years ago. Join us as we explore the Portuguese and Arab roles in these horrific trade schemes. We'll also investigate the pristine waters off the coast of the nearby National Park where our host dons a snorkel mask and comes face-to-face with the creatures of the coral reef.

Few people know that Gandhi got his political activist start in South Africa. This is a city where Asia meets Africa and is one of the most diverse cities in the world. Here Journeys encounters people of European, Far Eastern and Indian descent as well as the local Zulus.

Follow breathtaking travel adventures of some well known athletes of extreme sports. Have a look at some stunning locations in Alaska, Mexico, Argentina, Japan, Tahiti, Africa, Costa Rica, Norway, Hawaii and whitewater kayaking, extreme big mountain skiing, windsurfing, kiteboarding, extreme snowboarding and big wave surfing that push the limits of possibility. The focus is on compelling personalities and great storytelling.

February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I simply cannot wait for more!

Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

Giants of San Benedicto features Dr. Robert Rubin and his ground-breaking research of giant Mantas. You'll travel to the remote Socorro Islands off Mexico's Pacific coast and see breath-taking encounters with enormous manta rays. You're sure to love these majestic giants as you see how they invite human contact, and encourage certain divers to ride them. The film crew also travels to the Bahamas to visit 'Bubbles', a fifteen foot Manta in the worlds largest aquarium, and witness her release back into the ocean.

Tetovēšanas salona īpašnieks Deniss Ābrahamsens atrasts brutāli noslepkavots, kails uz masāžas galda savās mājās. Pierādījumi liecina par traku seksa ballīti, kas ar slavenu pieaugušo aktrisi beigusies nelāgi.

Nakts vidū savās mājās Klīrvoterā Floridā pazūd astoņus gadus vecais Zakerijs Bernhards. Viņa māte bija uz brīdi devusies īsā peldē uz dzīvokļu kompleksa peldbaseinu, bet, pārnākot mājās, Zakerijs nebija savā gultā. Tāpat nebija atrodamas ielaušanās pazīmes..

Als no apavu veikala pieņem priekšlaicīgas pensionēšanās finansējumu 12 tūkstošu dolāru apmērā. Pegija atrod naudu un to iztērē vienas stundas laikā. Als ir spiests atgriezties darbā, kur viņš uzzina par iespēju iegādāties apavu veikalu ar nosaukumu "Home Plate Athletic Shoes".

Ofisā strādā arī Dvaits Štrūts, iedomīgs reģionālā menedžera asistents, Raiens Hovards - jauns, gudrs, ar sevi pārņemts vīrietis, kā arī citi kolorīti tēli. Draudzenes apmeklē Stellas bāra atklāšanu un pieņem svarīgus lēmumus par savām attiecībām, karjeru un nākotni. Džūlsa sarūpē Medisonei dzimšanas dienas pārsteigumu.
Maikls nolemj Martu pakļaut Goba sieviešu apmānīšanai, liekot viņai piedalīties burvju trikā. Tajā iesaistīta viena no daudzajām Goba draudzenēm.
Basters lūdz Džordžam Maiklam nopirkt viņam marihuānu, lai ārstētu Lusilas Ostero reiboni. Maikls sarīko viltus aizturēšanu, lai Džordžs Maikls gūtu mācību.

Kādu rītu Als atklāj, ka viņa Dodge ir nozagts. Pēc Džefersona ierosinājuma Als nolemj apkrāpt apdrošināšanas kompāniju, un iznomā Lincoln Town Car... Līdz policija atrod viņa mīļoto transportlīdzekli.

Bada brālēns izšķīries, uzzinot, ko viņa sieva izdarīja ar Badu tieši pirms kāzām. Pareizāk sakot, viņš precīzi nezina, ka tas bija Bads, bet apņēmies to noskaidrot. Kamēr Bads gaida, kas notiks, viņš no visiem cilvēkiem vēršas pie Ala, lai pārrunātu savas rīcības morāli.

p.d: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

Успешная бизнес-леди Катя узнает, что её дочь пыталась покончить жизнь самоубийством. Как оказалось, не впервые. Чтобы быть ближе к дочери и понять, чем на самом деле занимаются дети в школе, она начинает работать учительницей экономики. Молодая мама понятия не имела, какие секреты скрываются за стенами обычной школы. Тогда же в учебное заведение приходит новый преподаватель английского - бывший адвокат и сын директора Алекс. У него есть невеста, которая живет в США, но вдруг между ним и Екатериной промелькнула искра. Впрочем, скелеты прошлого всё ещё дают о себе знать и не отпускают героев...

Главный герой - не только художник, но и настоящий аферист. Его картины-копии не всякий эксперт отличит от оригинала. Пока подделка висит во многих галереях страны, настоящее произведение искусства "уплывает" в частную коллекцию подпольных любителей живописи. Все это – и виртуозные кражи, и тщательные подделки – дело рук одного человека – Андрея Бойко...

В почтовое отделение на должность экспедитора устраивается Елена (40 лет). Экспедитор Андрей (45) не очень доволен новой напарницей, он не доверяет женщинам за рулем. Но со временем между Еленой и Андреем возникает симпатия. И не без стараний со стороны их детей – Юли и Глеба. Андрей – одинокий папа, Елена - одинокая мама, казалось бы, ничего не может помешать их отношениям… Но тайны и ошибки прошлого сыграют с ними злую шутку… Бушуют страсти и в почтовом отделении. Руководитель отделения Артем (30) покоряет вершины почтовой карьеры и не желает замечать сотрудницу отделения Милану (25), которая мечтает заполучить его сердце. Мама Артема и его младший брат Гена также вносят в жизнь отделения свои коррективы… Все герои ежедневно сталкиваются с нестандартными ситуациями, но не остаются равнодушными к проблемам людей-клиентов почтового отделения, помогая им выпутаться из сложных историй…

Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

A young, Chinese dragon punished by the gods to be a mere mortal is cast down to earth. He is forced to make his way in a strange land until the evil forces discover his true identity. Take part in a world full of imagination while following the journey of a mischievous dragon who has been transformed by magic into a little boy and exiled from his home to live among humans. When both good and evil forces learn that a dragon has arrived, they look for him as he is the only one who can find the magical sword—whose owner can rule the universe! Will he find the sword in time before it gets into the wrong hands? Will he ever become a dragon again?

Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius.

A hard-working cupcake maker is inadvertently elected mayor of a small town burdened with debt. With no formal experience or education to speak of, she must rely on her street smarts to clean up the town.

Summertime. Everybody is excited to go on vacation to Italy. Everybody but Jasmin. Jasmin is yearning something. She wants to be with Eva, her mother, from whom she had to live seperately for a long time. For weeks, Jasmin is trying to get close to Eva. She does not give up, even if she's rejected. After an argument, Jasmin runs away from her fosterhome and convinces Eva to leave the city together and go on a trip. The two get closer -- sometimes as friends, sometimes as mother and daughter. A first joint cigarette, a dance in the village disco, wanderings through the woods. But expectations and needs of the girl and her mother are diverging repeatedly, especially when a man attracts Eva's attention and disturbs the growing closeness between mother and daughter.

Kevin, Samantha and Rob live for Foolproof; their own private club where through high-tech, meticulously thought out and executed plans, they pull off the most impossible of heists - all in theory that is. They've never actually done it for real. But all that changes when Leo, a cutthroat British gangster, rips off their foolproof plans for a diamond heist and uses it to successfully execute the robbery. Threatening to implicate them, Leo blackmails them to pull off a robbery worth $20 million in corporate bonds.

Charlie, a culinary genius, has lost the motivation. He doesn't know what to with his life anymore, but he knows one thing - get close to Amber. In comparison to her boyfriend, he seems to be totally unattractive, but Charlie's closest friend convinces him that where there's a will there's a way.

When Eleroo advises Bumblelion to make a wish when getting the biggest part of the wishbone, it means trouble for poor Rhinokey for losing two bank bags of money. Bumblelion starts spending the money and looses his friends while Rhinokey manages to escape from Officer Eaglebeagle. Rhinokey tries to convince Bumblelion to return the bank bags, but Bumblelion decides to run off thinking that Rhinokey wants to steal his money. Soon after, Bumblelion realizes how Rhinokey lost the bank bags and returns the money to the police.

In London 1939, before the beginning of the Second World War, Thomas and his wife Massie run the Say When jazz club. But when he starts having an affair with singer Butterfly, their world disintegrates into blackmail, drugs, and suicide.

THE ZODIAC takes a different look at the famous Zodiac Killer case from other screen treatments of the murders. More than a simple crime story, the film is an emotional thriller focusing on the murders' impact on victims, their families and the wider community. The film follows a police detective and his son who become obsessed with the murders and endanger their family in the process.

Remembrance depicts a remarkable love story that blossomed amidst the terror of a German concentration camp in 1944 Poland. This impossible passion fuels the courage of a Polish prisoner who manages to rescue his Jewish girlfriend. Against all odds, they escape the camp and survive a treacherous journey to freedom. But during the chaos of the end of the war, they are forcibly separated and each is convinced that the other has died. More than thirty years later in New York, the happily married 52-year-old woman accidentally finds out that her former Polish lover is still alive. And she has to see him again.

Max Richards, a teenage boy born with a medical condition of being lethally attractive, who is changed forever when he meets Alex, a girl with her own bizarre ailment, who aids him on his quest of self-discovery... without accidentally killing someone.

In the near future, war, climate and political agendas have robbed America of its lush resources. Seeds rarely grow into vegetation, the water is mostly polluted, and people are obligated to work hard to earn their keep. Noah Kross (Nicolas Cage) is an agent of "the Humanity Bureau," a government agency that determines a person's productivity. Kross's reports are key factors in deciding who stays in America and who is deported to New Eden. Kross is in charge of managing the deportation of a former governor of Colorado who now lives in misery, who claims to know "the truth" before seeking to kill Kross and then being shot by him. Kross ends up discovering that New Eden is really an extermination camp where the excess unproductive population is liquidated and incinerated.

A South Central L.A. con artist with rap skills tries to keep bill collectors and his lover, with marriage in mind, at bay by entering a poetry contest staged by a small Irish town. Can his rhyming skills help the town and win him the prize money?

In December 1941, Japan expands the occupation of its neighbouring countries to Southeast Asia. The railway from Tianjin to Nanjing in East China became a key military transportation route, heavily guarded by Japanese soldiers. Railroad worker Ma Yuan (Jackie Chan) leads a team of freedom fighters. Using his deep knowledge of the train network, he and his men sabotage it, ambushing Japanese soldiers and stealing supplies to feed the starving Chinese. Although the freedom fighters have no weapons of their own, they employ whatever tools are at hand, including a hammer and shovels, loose railway track planks and diverted trains. The local Chinese call the unlikely heroes the "Railroad Tigers". The freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when the Japanese send reinforcements to Shandong. In an act of defiance, Ma Yuan launches his most dangerous mission yet, blowing up a heavily guarded railroad bridge. When the Japanese learn of the crippling plan, which will derail the war effort, the stakes are raised even higher. After many missed opportunities and missed shots, the bridge is blown up by the ragtag Chinese railroad tigers.

Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.

Kzavjē dzīve ir sarežģītāka nekā jebkad iepriekš. Viņš ir rakstnieks, dzīvo Parīzē kopā ar savu bērnu māti Vendiju, kura pēc ceļojuma uz Ņujorku paziņo, ka vēlas šķirties, jo satikusi kādu citu. Parīzē dzīvo arī Kzavjē draudzene Izabella, kura ir kopā ar ķīniešu izcelsmes amerikānieti. Sievietes vēlas bērnu un pierunā Kzavjē kļūt par spermas donoru, pirms pašas pārvāksies uz Ņujorku. Kad arī Vendija paziņo, ka kopā ar bērniem pārvāksies uz Ņujorku pie vīrieša, ar kuru nesen iepazinās, Kzavjē saprot, ka viņam nav izvēles - ja visi viņa bērni būs Ņujorkā, arī viņam jādodas turp.
Vinsenta automašīna saplīst uz kalnu ceļa, kas noved viņu pie dzīvi mainošas tikšanās ar Pjēru.

1951. gada beigās Eilisa Leisija (Sīrša Ronana) pamet Īriju un dodas uz Bruklinu, lai sāktu jaunu dzīvi, atbalstot savu ģimeni. Viņai palīdz tēvs Flads, un Eilisa drīz nonāk dzīves ritenī, strādājot universālveikalā un studējot grāmatvedību. Kad viņa saskatās ar itāļu izcelsmes amerikāņu santehniķi, viņa saprot, ka ir pilnībā iemīlējusies. Taču pēc traģiska negadījuma viņai jādodas atpakaļ mājās, kur atjauno saites ar bijušajiem draugiem un mēģina izprast, kur veidot savu dzīvi tālāk.
Jauna sieviete, kas iesprostota vardarbīgās attiecībās, neapzināti kļūst par savu divu tuvāko draudzeņu sarīkotās iejaukšanās dalībnieci.

Zemi iekaro citplanētu iebrucēji, un pēc piecu gadu cīņām viņi ir gandrīz iekarojuši Eiropu. Ģenerālis Brigems (Brendans Glīsons) nosūta majoru Viljamu Keidžu (Toms Krūzs) kā dezertieri uz savu jauno vienību – J vadu. Jau pirmajā kaujā Keidžu nogalina, taču viņš šokēts atmostas iepriekšējā dienā. Izmisīgos centienos izlauzties no apnicīgās laika cilpas, Keidžu sāk trenēt elites kareive Rita Vrataski (Emīlija Blanta), kura ir cilvēces pretošanās simbols. Viņas vadībā Keidžs kļūst par Zemes labāko ieroci un iespēju, kā iznīcināt citplanētu iebrucējus.

Amerikāņu multimiljonāra un avantūrista Hovarda Hjūza galvu reibinošs dzīvesstāsts Pēc tēva nāves Hovardam tiek lielākā daļa no kompānijas "Hughes Tool Co" akcijām. Slavenā naftas urbumu mašīnas izgudrotāja dēls pārvērš nelielu fabriku par fantastisku, gigantisku, dzīvības pārpildītu ienesīgu uzņēmumu. Nauda dedzina Hjūza sirdi, tā nedod viņam miera, bet dvēsele alkst pēc kā lielāka.
Seriāls stāsta par četriem bijušajiem ASV armijas specvienības karavīriem, kuri, netaisnīgi apsūdzēti noziegumā, bēg no militārās policijas un palīdz cilvēkiem, kuri nonākuši nelaimē.

Dziedātājs. Nemiernieks. Izraidītais. Varonis. Džonijs Kešs. Ar tik smagiem akordiem, kas spētu aizkustināt pat kravas vilcienu, tēraudpelēko acu intensīvo skatienu un balsi, tumšu kā nakts, leģendārais "Vīrs melnā" sarīkoja mūzikā revolūciju un pats radīja savu īstas amerikāņu leģendas imidžu. Būdams cilvēks, kura dzīvi vada spēcīgas kaislības, Džonijs Kešs nekad neatteicās no savas kontraversālās personības. Savas karjeras sākumā viņš satika vienīgo patieso savu mūža mīlestību Džūnu Kārteri, kas spēja viņu glābt no sevis paša.
Algots slepkava, kurš cieš no strauji progresējošas demences formas, iegūst iespēju izpirkt savu pagātni, izglābjot sava atsvešinātā pieaugušā dēla dzīvību.
Pēc veiksmīgas gladiatoru izbēgšanas Spartaks vada atbrīvoto vergu armiju, vienlaikus izvēloties starp personīgo atriebību pret Romas ģenerāli Glāberu un cīņu par brīvību.
Salā uz Misisipi upes divi jauni zēni satiek svešinieku, kurš stāsta trakus pasakas par galvasnaudas medniekiem un kādu skaistu sievieti.

Bruklinas noziedzniekam Džovanni Manzoni bija viss līdz mirklim, kad viņš kļuva par bandītu nodevēju. Lai cik reižu aģents Stensfīlds pārvietotu Džovanni un viņa ģimeni, briesmas arvien pastāv. Kad ģimene kārtējo reizi tiek atrasta, Džovanni liek savai sievai Megijai un abiem bērniem Vorenam un Bellai pārcelties uz klusu ciematu Francijā. Tā šķiet ideāla vieta, kur izbēgt no noziedznieku vērīgajām acīm, taču ģimene ar pieredzi kriminālajā pasaulē atgriežas pie netīrā darba, kārtējo reizi nonākot sindikāta redzeslokā.

Eight of the most talented chefs in the country receive a mysterious invitation to stay and cook at a spooky, isolated hotel. In the end, only the most talented, strategic and resourceful chef will end their stay at the hotel $25,000 richer.

In Food Network's series Kids Baking Championship, hosts and judges Duff Goldman and Valerie Bertinelli will lead eight talented kid bakers through challenges designed to find the most-impressive and creative young baker. In each challenge the contestants, ranging in age from 10 to 13, will be tested on their baking skills and originality as they whip up delectable desserts, including creative cakes, mouthwatering cookies and pastries.

Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

Unique ingredients are featured in the baskets of the future. Sustainable squash, Little Neck clams, algae oil, and black ants are in the appetizer basket. During the entrée round, chefs are to prepare tasty dishes using sunflowers, ostrich fillet, fonio, and solar farm honey. Meatless breakfast sausage, pea protein milk, astronaut peaches, and organic cacao powder are to be used in the dessert round.

After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?
Esther Choi makes some favourite Korean classics - Korean barbecue of LA Kalbi with Ssamjangand and a hot pot: bulgogi mushroom jeongol.
Esther Choi teaches how to make two types of kimchi and shares kimchi recipes, including kimchi fried rice and Korean pork belly wraps.
Maneet Chauhan is cooking up her signature shortcut recipe for a classic chicken tikka masala, followed by a vegetarian feast of aloo gobi.
Maneet Chauhan prepares a crowd-pleasing appetizer of crispy fried Samosas with a creamy potato pea filling and a spicy main course of pork vindaloo.

Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

Savā grāmatā piedzīvojumu kārais Haralds var atdzīvināt jebko, to vienkārši uzzīmējot. Pieaugot un attālinoties no grāmatas lappusēm un nonākot reālajā pasaulē, Haralds saprot, ka viņam ir daudz jāmācās par īsto dzīvi.

Ir 1613. gads, un Šekspīrs jau novērtēts kā šī laikmeta lieliskākais rakstnieks. Tomēr notiek traģēdija, un viņa slavenais Globe teātris Londonā nodeg līdz pašiem pamatiem. Saguris Šekspīrs atgriežas Stretfordā, kur viņam jāsaskaras ar savu smago pagātni un nolaidīgo ģimeni. Sava vienīgā dēla Hamneta nāves vajāts, viņam ir grūtības salabot attiecības ar ģimeni. Tomēr, to cenšoties, viņš ir spiests atkal un atkal izvērtēt savas neveiksmes.

Kad kosmosa kuģis cieš avāriju un Villijs tiek nošķirts no saviem vecākiem, viņš nokļūst uz mežonīgas un neizpētītas planētas, kur ar izdzīvošanas robota Baka palīdzību būs jānoturas, līdz ieradīsies glābšanas komanda.
Kad Čihiro vecāki tiek pārvērsti cūkās, viņa spiesta strādāt pirtī, kuru vada ragana. Starp gariem un brīnumainām būtnēm viņa atrod drosmi un labestību. "Ghibli" šedevrs apbur ar emocijām.

Jauna dāma, meklējot dzīvei uguntiņu, pavada romantisku nakti kopā ar kādu jaunekli. Atklādama, ka vīrietis ir nedziedināmi slims, sieviete apņemas palīdzēt viņam pilnvērtīgi nodzīvot pēdējās šeit atvēlētās dienas.

p.t: Snūpijs un Čārlijs Brauns: Riekstiņu filma
p.d: Čarlijs Brauns, Snūpijs un visi pārējie atgriežas ar šo aizkustinošo stāstu. Kad apkārtnē uz dzīvi apmetas jauna sarkanmataina meitene, Čārlijs Brauns viņā iemīlas. Viņš vairākkārt mēģina pievērst jaunās meitenes uzmanību un dažādos veidos mēģina savā dzīvē kaut ko sasniegt, taču katru reizi šķiet, ka neveicas arvien vairāk. Vai viņam izdosies iepatikties savai mīlestībai? Tajā pašā laikā Snūpijs apņemas tikt galā ar savu ļaunāko ienaidnieku - Sarkano Baronu.

Kosmosa kuģirs avarē uz svešas planētas. Izdzīvojušajam astronautam jāšķērso skarbā planēta! Bēgot no nezināmām radībām, viņam jācenšas neiztērēt visu skābekli. Vienīgais kas viņu dzen uz priekšu, ir cerība satikt otru izdzīvojušo.

Vāciešu okupētajā Francijā Šosanna Dreifusa kļūst par liecinieci tam, kā nacistu pulkvedis Hanss Landa noslepkavo viņas ģimeni. Šosannai par mata tiesu izdodas izsprukt un aizbēgt uz Parīzi, kur viņa pieņem citu identitāti un kļūst par kinoteātra īpašnieci. Tajā pašā laikā kaut kur citur Eiropā leitnants Aldo Reins sapulcina grupu ebreju kareivju, kuru mērķis ir atriebties ienaidniekam. Nacistiem šis grupējums kļūst pazīstams ar nosaukumu "mērģļi". Reina grupējumam pievienojas jauna vācu aktrise un slepenā aģente Bridžeta fon Hameršmarka, kuras uzdevums ir gāzt Trešā reiha vadoņus. Likteņa pavērsieni saved visus kopā ar Šosannu, kurai ir pašai savs atriebības plāns….

Bens Bārbers (Kevins Hārts) gatavojas precēties ar saderināto Andželu (Tika Samptere), kura ir viņa policijas partnera Džeimsa (Aiss Kjūbs) māsa. Policistus nosūta uzdevumā uz Maiami, lai izmeklētu nežēlīgā narkotiku tirgoņa Antonio Poupa (Bendžamins Brats) nodarījumus, par kuru ir zināms, ka tas apgādā visu Maiami ar narkotikām. Viņi apvienojas ar bezkompromisu detektīvi Maju (Olīvija Manna) un dodas pārtraukt Poupa darbību. Spriedze palielinās, tuvojoties Bena un Andželas kāzām.

Maks (Sets Rogens) un Kellija (Roza Bairna) gaida otru bērnu un nolemj pārvākties uz citurieni. Viņu plānam traucē Šelbija (Hloja Greisa Moreca), kura mēģina nodibināt studenšu klubu, lai viņa ar draugiem varētu rīkot savas ballītes. Abas grupas drīzumā kļūst par zvērinātiem ienaidniekiem, jo atšķiras to uzskati par skaļu mūziku un nepārtrauktu dzerstiņu. Maks un Kellija drīz sauc palīgā bijušo ienaidnieku Tediju (Zaks Efrons), lai neļautu kubam "Kappa Nu" turpināt traucēt dzīvi apkārtnē.

Kas jauns mošķu pasaulē? Kāzas! Ragana un viņas iemīļotais Renfīlds, grāfa Drakulas sulainis, nolēmuši neslēpt savas jūtas un... salaulāties! Taču nupat sākusies laulību ceremonija tūdaļ pārtrūkst. Viesu acu priekšā mīlētājus nolaupa ar pārcilvēciskām spējām apveltītā mošķu medniece Mila. Šai mazulītei labāk netuvoties. Viņa ir ātrāka par vēju un apgādāta ar vismodernākajām tehnoloģijām - tās ieraugot, pat Džeimss Bonds viņu apskaustu.
Kādam mazpilsētas tēvam jāatrod drosme un pārliecība pastāstīt pasaulei par sava mazā dēla īpašo, dzīvi mainošo pieredzējumu.

Reiz uz kādas paradīzes salas dzīvoja putni, kas nemācēja lidot. Tāpēc viņi visi bija labi, miermīlīgi un laimīgi... Precīzāk, gandrīz visi. Uz pārējo salas iemītnieku fona depresīvais Reds, trauksmainais Čaks un neveiklais Bumba izcēlās ar savu neparedzamo uzvedību un skaitījās izstumtie. Taču, kad salā pēkšņi parādījās noslēpumainās zaļās cūkas, kam noteikti aiz ādas bija kāda cūcība, tieši Reds, Čaks un Bumba stājās viņiem pretī!

Nelidojošie dusmīgie putni joprojām karo ar viltīgajām zaļajām cūkām. Viņi ir ļaunākie ienaidnieki, un, šķiet, nekas nespēs to mainīt. Taču, kad pie apvāršņa parādās jaunas briesmas, kas apdraud viņus visus, putniem un cūkām nāksies apvienoties, lai glābtu savas mājas.
Stāsts par karaļa Luija XV pēdējo oficiālo mīļāko Dibarī kundzi.

La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

p.d: After a year-long wait, Kamohai and Tristyn face a never-ending nightmare after squatters have taken over a property in Waipahu, causing chaos and delays. And with a freeway nearby, Tristyn also faces the challenge of designing soundproofing solutions.

Designer Michel Smith Boyd uses clever budget hacks to help homeowners create luxurious renovations without stretching their bank accounts. Along with his creative team, Michel brings upscale design within reach to deliver beautifully overhauled spaces in the Atlanta, Georgia area.

American home improvement series. Presenter Jasmine Roth visits the homes of DIY catastrophes to restore them back to a liveable space. Jasmine brings in the professionals to rescue these renovations-gone-wrong and helps homeowners realise their property's full potential. With half-demolished houses, unfinished floors and plumbing nightmares: these refurbishment mishaps are on a monumental scale. Luckily, with expertise, hard work and vision, Jasmine and her team can hopefully transform these DIY disasters into something beautiful that their owners will love.

Attempting to bring families' dreams come to life, but on a budget, Beachfront Bargain Hunt shows that you don't have to be a millionaire if you want to live a life by the sea! Narrated by John Beach, this show follows a number of couples, families and people looking just for themselves exploring various beachfront's in USA, looking for homes that won't break the bank. Ensuring each person gets what they want, they are introduced to a number of properties that meet their ultimate dream home in the hopes that they will indeed find the one. With 101 episodes, Beachfront Bargain Hunt introduces you to the life that can be led, without breaking to bank, to live a life by the sea!

Cappie and Alex work to achieve the impossible - they design an ambitious subterranean "co-cave" built deep into a hillside for their clients.

Recent lottery winners look for their perfect dream house in this "House Hunters"-inspired reality show. David Bromstad takes recent lottery winners on over-the-top house hunts for their new dream homes. Whether they win hundreds of thousands or hundreds of millions, lucky lottery winners everywhere are jumping headfirst into the real estate market. Will they spend all their winnings on an extravagant mansion or settle for a humble sound investment? Find out what happens when average Americans set out to find "My Lottery Dream Home".

Wisconsin transplants Eric and Lindsey Bennett are transforming sunny Palm Springs, California one dilapidated house at a time. Renovating 20 properties a year while raising two small children is no small feat, and this couple takes it in stride. But when you go behind the walls of houses that live in triple-digit heat, you never know what you might find, scorpions, rattlesnakes, black widows and even squatters. In each episode of Desert Flippers , Eric and Lindsey search out a diamond in the rough, but they might find something that's just plain rough.

Barnwood Builders is an American documentary TV series following a team of builders that magically turn historic barns and log cabins into modern houses. Mark Bowe is the owner West Virginia company, he buys old barns and log cabins in order to reuse the hand-hewn logs. His professional team specializes in the reclamation and restoration of pioneer era structures in the eastern United States. The pioneers of modern days give pioneer cabins and barns a new life, they save barns with history and introduce the viewers to the incredible structures and american icons of building work.

Bargain Block follows home renovation experts and partners Keith Bynum and Evan Thomas on their journey to restore Detroit's iconic American neighborhoods one house at a time. With sound advice and support from their friend—lifetime Detroit resident and real estate expert Shea Hicks-Whitfield, who is expecting her first child—Keith and Evan buy multiple rundown and abandoned houses on a single block, take them down to the studs, and create affordable, stylish and fully furnished starter homes that are ideal for first-time homebuyers. Now settled in the Motor City, the couple, who have renovated and purchased their own home and opened a new retail store and workshop, infuse every property with a functional layout, artful design and beautiful repurposed furniture. The end result is incredible transformations of dilapidated homes that are an inspiration to the entire neighborhood.

We Bought A Funeral Home is an eerie new series that will unearth an unconventional side of the home renovation realm. The six episodes will document the quirky journey of Heather and Arryn Blumberg and their two kids, Rafferty and Noa, who trade in big city life to buy, renovate and design a 12,000-square-foot, 1800s Victorian funeral home in the small town of Dresden, Ontario.

Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

For the first time, the "Pawn Stars" are hitting the road to visit some of America's most exciting places in search of historical finds and impressive collectible objects in the new 8-part series "Pawn Stars Do America." Each two-hour episode follows Rick Harrison, Corey Harrison and Austin "Chumlee" Russell as they step out of the World Famous Gold & Silver Pawn Shop in Las Vegas to connect with fans in eight different cities and acquire some of the most remarkable items imaginable.

Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Each episode analyzes and passes verdicts on several seemingly impossible things "caught on film" including giant beasts, UFOS, apocalyptic sounds, hairy humans, alleged mutants from the deep, conspiracies, and many other cases. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.
